question: Should OpenClaw add a public persisted rootSessionKey and session-chain traceId contract for spawned sessions, and should that traceId be a new chain id or bridge existing diagnostic trace context?
rationale: The code change is bounded, but rootSessionKey and traceId would become public persisted session and Gateway contract fields, so another implementation attempt needs maintainer API intent first.

options.title: Add minimal spawn-chain contract
options.body: Add optional parent/root/trace/depth semantics for spawned sessions only, with additive schema, projections, docs, and tests, leaving traversal APIs for later.

options.title: Defer to resolver lineage direction
options.body: Keep this open until sessions.resolve/family lineage is settled, then align spawn-chain metadata with that broader contract.

options.title: Reject durable root/trace fields
options.body: Keep current parent/depth behavior and narrow future work to docs or tooling if maintainers do not want a new public chain identifier.

recommendation.title: Add minimal spawn-chain contract
recommendation.body: Add optional parent/root/trace/depth semantics for spawned sessions only, with additive schema, projections, docs, and tests, leaving traversal APIs for later.
